decision_authority: explicit_user decision ('Stop catastrophe k=3 oui ok'), audit_20261115 decision 6
does_not_modify: the netting rule r2 (its 'no overlay' clause refers to the rejected risk overlays: daily stop, MBT cap, volatility sizing, profit lock); this order never triggered on the history and leaves every sleeve's behaviour unchanged
purpose: bound an orphan position (disconnection, platform or code bug) at about 3 daily ATR; it is not an alpha stop and does not bound the day. The day is bounded by the Topstep 50K daily loss limit of 1 000 USD (account level, read on help.topstep.com on 2026-11-15).

rule.scope: one resting stop order per instrument (MNQ, MGC, MBT), at the broker, for the net position of the instrument
rule.atr: ATR14 of the previous session (J-1), in points: daily bars built from the 1-minute bars 09:30-16:00 New York on weekdays; true range = max(high - low, |high - previous close|, |low - previous close|); simple 14-session mean, shifted by one session
rule.level: long: average entry price - k x ATR(J-1); short: average entry price + k x ATR(J-1)

netting.open_from_flat: average price = fill; stop placed at the level above for the full quantity
netting.increase_same_side: average price weighted by quantity; stop level recomputed; quantity adjusted
netting.reduce: average price and stop level kept; quantity reduced
netting.reverse: average price = fill of the new side; stop recomputed on the other side

rule.after_trigger: the instrument stays flat until the end of the session; sleeves keep their virtual PnL and their own stop rule; S01's own stop and target orders are independent and remain in force
rule.missing_atr: if ATR(J-1) is not available (first 14 sessions of data), no catastrophe stop is placed and the session is flagged

evidence.history: MNQ and MGC 2019-05-06 -> 2026-03-19, MBT 2021-05-03 -> 2026-03-19, 1 775 sessions, reference book with S01 = ATR 18, aggregated execution without lot cap
evidence.limits: fill at the stop level minus one tick, gaps through the stop not modelled, 1-minute bars only

evidence_hash_note: sha256 of the file bytes after replacing CRLF by LF (the audit files are written with Windows line endings)
implementation_note: the repository holds no live execution engine; this file is the executable definition to be coded in the execution platform
